full_prompt_en: A square, tightly cropped pop art portrait centers on a defiant curly-haired performer shouting toward the viewer. The open mouth is exaggerated, the brows are knitted, and the direct stare feels confrontational. Dense curls form a dark blue-black halo that presses against the top edge. Bold turquoise and cyan shadow planes replace natural flesh tones, and rough black ink contours carve the face. Yellow lightning bolts and angular red shapes crowd behind and partly across the figure, turning the background into an energetic graphic burst. Saturated mustard yellow, hot red, electric blue, and deep teal sit in coarse printed layers. Halftone speckle, scratched surfaces, misregistered color, torn poster wear, and hand-drawn hatching remain visible throughout. The clothing is nearly black, so the face and lightning dominate. A tight crop pushes the features toward the viewer and makes the open mouth the strongest point of contrast. Uneven printed dots and scuffed color fields give each bright patch a physical surface. The jagged surrounding shapes repeat the vocal energy without becoming literal sound effects. The whole frame feels compressed, loud, and immediate, like a weathered punk concert poster or vintage comic cover. It retains the grit of old ink on paper rather than smooth digital blending or photographic realism.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、紧密裁切的波普艺术肖像将一位迎面呐喊的卷发演出者放在中央。张大的嘴略带夸张，眉头拧紧，直接的视线具有挑衅感。浓密卷发形成深蓝黑色光环，几乎顶住画面上缘。大胆的青绿和亮青色阴影色面取代自然肉色，粗糙黑墨轮廓刻出面孔。背景及人物身旁挤满黄色闪电和红色棱角形状，形成充满能量的图形爆发。饱和芥末黄、炽红、电蓝与深青绿落在粗粝的印刷色层中。半调颗粒、刮伤表面、错位套色、磨旧海报的破损和手绘排线通篇可见。衣服近乎黑色，让面孔与闪电占据主导。紧密裁切把五官推向观者，张开的嘴成为最强烈的对比点。不均匀的印刷网点和磨损色面让每块鲜色都有物理表面。周围锯齿状形体呼应喊声的能量，却不成为字面化的音效符号。整幅画面像风化的朋克演出海报或复古漫画封面，压迫、喧闹而直接。它保留旧纸上墨迹的粗粝，而没有光滑数字混色或摄影写实。
style_prompt_en: Apply a loud vintage pop print language with saturated cyan, deep teal, primary red, and mustard yellow trapped under forceful black linework. Compose with a close crop, a dark central mass, and jagged rays or lightning-like diagonals that push outward. Build volume from flat color planes and coarse hatching rather than smooth gradients. Overlay distressed paper, halftone flecks, scratches, cracks, and slight color misregistration so the surface feels like an old screen-printed poster. Keep the energy confrontational and immediate, with a compact hierarchy and strong contrast between dark ink and vivid color.
style_prompt_zh: 采用喧闹的复古波普印刷语言，让饱和亮青、深青绿、正红和芥末黄被有力的黑色线条框住。以紧密裁切、中央深色块和向外冲出的锯齿放射线或闪电状斜线组织构图。体积主要由平涂色面和粗排线构成，不用光滑渐变。叠加磨旧纸面、半调斑点、刮痕、裂纹和轻微套色错位，使表面像一张旧丝网印刷海报。画面能量要迎面而来，层级紧凑，深墨与鲜艳颜色形成强烈对比。
theme_en: A defiant curly-haired performer shouting amid lightning shapes
theme_zh: 卷发演出者在闪电形色块中发出呐喊
name: Butcher Billy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
